identity.title: Why Is God Hidden From Us? Lukas Ruegger vs Alex O'Connor

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

participants.basis: Brierley introduces the topic, asks prompts, and manages turns without sustaining an independent argumentative route in the main discussion. O'Connor and Ruegger are the only two advocates who repeatedly advance and answer the competing divine-hiddenness cases between 00:02:40 and the explicit close at 01:10:09. The complete source was reviewed, but the separately introduced postscript beginning at 01:10:09 is aftershow commentary in which Max Baker-Hytch joins the three participants; it is outside the titled dyadic debate and contributes no scored move.

duplicateAudit.distinctExistingSpeakerDebates: O'Connor appears in prior corpus debates, including another divine-hiddenness exchange, while Ruegger is new to the corpus; no existing record uses this 2022 source, this pairing, or this exact loving-God hiddenness motion.
